(subsidy)a. pension Mi abuelo cobra su pensión a finales de mes.My grandfather draws his pension at the end of the month.b. allowance El gobierno subió las pensiones de invalidez en un 10%.The government raised disability allowances by 10%.2. (rented living quarters)a. accomodations Regionalism used in the United States(United States)Busco pensión para mí y mi hija de 10 años.I'm looking for accommodations for me and my ten-year-old daughter.b. accommodation Regionalism used in the United Kingdom(United Kingdom)Se ofrece pensión en la avenida de Barcelona.Accommodation available in Avenida de Barcelona.c. guesthouse ¿Conoces alguna pensión barata en la ciudad?Do you know any cheap guesthouses in the city?d. boarding house Durante el trimestre, vive en una pensión cerca de la universidad.During term time, he lives in a boarding house near the university.e. hostel No quedan habitaciones libres en ninguna pensión.There are no vacant rooms in any of the hostels.f. lodgings Mi hijo está buscando pensión con una familia.My son is looking for lodgings with a family.3. (pension)a. room and board Regionalism used in the United States(United States)La mayoría de las universidades incluyen la pensión en la colegiaturaMost universities include room and board in the cost of tuition.b. board and lodging Regionalism used in the United Kingdom(United Kingdom)Este semestre voy a vivir en casa de un primo para no tener que pagar pensión.This semester I'm going to live with a cousin so as not to pay for board and lodging.c. board (meals only) Regionalism used in the United Kingdom(United Kingdom)¿Desea reservar la habitación con o sin pensión?Would you like to book your room with or without board?4. (parking)a. monthly parking lot Regionalism used in the United States(United States)No hay estacionamiento en nuestra calle, así que dejamos el coche en una pensión.There's no parking on our street, so we leave our car in a monthly parking lot.b. monthly car park Regionalism used in the United Kingdom(United Kingdom)Cuando vengas de vacaciones, tendrás que dejar el coche en una pensión cerca de aquí.When you come on vacation, you'll need to leave your car in a monthly car park near here.Copyright © 2026 Dictionary Media Group, Inc.ExamplesExamples have not been reviewed.pension (5,402)board
